; Freehold SMT-LIB query
(set-logic ALL)
(declare-const cap Int)
(declare-const customer_active Int)
(declare-const customer_id Int)
(declare-const requested Int)
(declare-const result_approved Int)
(assert (> customer_id 0))
(assert (= customer_active true))
(assert (> requested 0))
(assert (>= cap requested))
(assert (not (= result_approved true)))
(check-sat)
; unsat means proved
